g.ns2:text: \\noindent$ub=1\\\\\nlb=0\\\\\n0.5 \\nless 0 \\text{, then }h2 \\text{ is active}\\\\\n0 \\nless 0 \\text{, then }h2 \\text{ is active, but is suppressed by } h2$
\\noindent$ub=0\\\\\nlb=0\\\\\n0.5 > 0 \\text{, then }h1\\text{ is not active}\\\\\n0 \\ngtr 0 \\text{, then } h1 \\text{ is active. Must also suppress } h2$

\\noindent bias is 1 and weight is -1\\\\\n$h_5=h_4\\cdot w_1+b\\cdot w_2\\\\\nh_5=h_4\\cdot 1 + 1\\cdot-1 \\\\\nh_5=h_4-1\\\\\nlb=0\\text{, if } h_5 \\geq 0 \\text{ then } h_5 \\text{ is active, else } h_5 \\text{ is not active}\n$
set weights to 0 and leave bias as 1
\\noindent$ub=1\\\\\nlb=0.5\\\\\n0.5 \\nless 0.5 \\text{, then }h2 \\text{ is active}\\\\\n0 < 0.5 \\text{, then }h2 \\text{ is not active }$
\\noindent$ub=1\\\\\nlb=0\\\\\n0.5 \\ngtr 1 \\text{, then }h1\\text{ is active}\\\\\n0 \\ngtr 1 \\text{, then } h1 \\text{ is active}$

\\noindent bias is 1 and weight is 1\\\\\n$h_5=h_4\\cdot w_1+b\\cdot w_2\\\\\nh_5=h_4\\cdot 1 + 1\\cdot 1 \\\\\nh_5=h_4+1\\\\\nlb=-1\\text{, if } h_5 \\geq 0 \\text{ then } h_5 \\text{ is active, else } h_5 \\text{ is not active}\n$
set weights to 0 and leave bias as 1

\\begin{adjustwidth}{0cm}{8.1cm}\nNeurons update to make the outgoing neurons active? If so the neurons can push the updates to propagate their signals in an unbalanced network that kills their signal. \n\\end{adjustwidth}

\\begin{adjustwidth}{0cm}{5cm}\nIf neurons update to make the outgoing neurons active, we can make the output neurons activation depend on close the prediction is to the expected output. That way the neurons can receive feedback from the output\n\\end{adjustwidth}

\\noindent For $x_1 = 3$\\\\\n$h_4=1.5\\\\\nh_1= h_4\\cdot w_1 + b\\\\\nh_1=1.5\\cdot w_1 + b$\\\\\nConsider $b=0$ and $w_1=1$\\\\\n$h_1=1.5\\\\\nlb = -1, ub=0$\\\\\n$1.5 > 0$ so $h_1$ is not active\\\\\n$h_4$ needs to go down for $h_1$ to be active
